title: Time for lower end to reach A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the free-fall time for the rod's lower end to reach point A, using the correct height (15 m).

title: Time for upper end to reach A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the free-fall time for the rod's upper end to reach point A, using the correct height (20 m).

title: Time interval for passing A
description: Essential: Correctly computes t1 as the difference between the times for the upper and lower ends to reach point A.

title: Time for upper end to reach B
description: Important: Correctly calculates the free-fall time for the rod's upper end to reach point B, using the correct height (25 m).

title: Time interval for passing cylinder
description: Essential: Correctly computes t2 as the difference between the time for the upper end to reach B and the lower end to reach A.

title: Correct final symbolic form
description: Optional: Presents the final answers in the simplified symbolic form ((2-√3) s and (√5-√3) s).

title: Confusing rod and cylinder geometry
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect heights by confusing the positions of the rod's ends relative to the cylinder's ends (A and B).

title: Incorrect time interval logic
description: Pitfall: Calculates the passing time as the difference between the wrong pair of events (e.g., lower end at B minus lower end at A).
